name: Loading panel · Pulse Ring
purpose: Initial lineup, market, player-detail and route loading states.
typography: AT Aero status 12px/140%, weight 400; optional Anton section title 20px/130%, weight 400.
colors: Main: outer ring #FF4B44 both modes. Secondary: inner ring #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: panel surface #FFFFFF / #24242B.
shape: Square panel with 20–24px padding. Circular rings are the explicit animation exception. Ring sizes 16, 32, 48, 64px; proportional inner inset 22%; allow at least 12px outer breathing room.
changes: Replace fixed rose/zinc classes with semantic tokens. Replace inset-2 with proportional inset so sm does not collapse. Apply the provided PulseRing.tsx and CSS; use one live status label, aria-hidden rings and reduced-motion fallback. Replace page skeleton gradients with a flat pulse.
snippet:
<section className="fb-panel" aria-busy="true">
  <PulseRing size="lg" label="Loading lineup…" />
</section>
behavior: A 1.4s expanding coral outline and gently pulsing inner outline; no flashing or scale motion in reduced-motion mode. Keep partial refresh loaders local; never block a usable page for background polling.
integration: Replace the status paragraph in LineupPage.tsx and Suspense fallback in App.tsx; review MarketScreenLoading and PlayerScreenLoading.

name: Buttons
purpose: Save lineup, submit a bid, confirm filters, secondary actions and icon actions.
typography: AT Aero; 14px default / 16px large; weight 600; 100% line height; 0.01em tracking; uppercase key actions.
colors: Main: primary/destructive fill #FF4B44. Secondary: label/icon #000000 on the primary fill. Tertiary: hover coral #FFC2BF / #B85A55, with label #35353D / #FFFFFF. Outline buttons use neutral surface and content.
shape: 8px corners for standalone actions; 0px in nav bars, attached control groups and row-integrated graphic elements. Heights 36/44/48px; touch actions ≥44px; 18px primary icon; 8px icon gap. Content centered in both axes.
changes: Complete native React implementation is included in code/Button.tsx and Appendix A. Use size, shape, variant and loading props. Replace the generated shadcn Button default styles or use this native version, preserving the public native button props. Remove shadow, ring-shadow and transition-all utilities. Links use buttonVariants on Link, never a button with link semantics.
snippet:
<Button icon={<Save aria-hidden="true" />} loading={savePending}
  disabled={!hasChanges} onClick={saveLineup}>Save lineup</Button>
<Button variant="outline" shape="square">Apply filters</Button>
behavior: 160ms fill/border/text transitions; no jump or glow. Default button type is button; submit is explicit. Busy state blocks repeat submission. Icon-only actions need aria-label; keep a visible pending label for longer operations. Success and destructive actions share coral but are distinguished by icon and wording.
integration: Map existing save-lineup-button, recommend-button and MarketActionDialogs actions. Keep existing disabled eligibility, confirmation and mutation handlers.

name: Breadcrumb
purpose: Player-detail location under Players, while top navigation stays limited to three destinations.
typography: AT Aero 12px/140%; links weight 400, current page weight 500; 0.01em tracking; sentence case player names.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Unboxed horizontal list with 8px gaps; 12px chevron separators. Ellipsis trigger is a square 36px control with a 44px touch target when needed.
changes: Use React Router Link in BreadcrumbLink render. Provide children explicitly: the supplied self-closing link examples have no visible label. Style BreadcrumbList with fb-breadcrumb and current-page text with tertiary ink. Overflow uses a square DropdownMenu.
snippet:
<BreadcrumbLink render={<Link to="/players" />}>Players</BreadcrumbLink>
<BreadcrumbPage>{player.name}</BreadcrumbPage>
behavior: aria-current=page on current item; separators decorative. Keyboard focus and underline accompany hover. Do not create fictitious nested nav pages.
integration: Place above the existing PlayerDetailPage title; use the current /players/:playerId route.

name: Calendar
purpose: Fixture date selection and calendar views.
typography: Anton month title 18px/130%, weight 400; AT Aero day numbers 14px/140%, weight 500; weekday labels 12px/140%, weight 500.
colors: Main: neutral surface #FFFFFF / #24242B. Secondary: day text #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: selected day #FF4B44 with #000000 content; today uses a tertiary-ink outline.
shape: Square calendar and cells; ≥36px day cells in compact desktop view, 44px on touch. Caption selectors have 0px corners. Calendar width around 320px; keep seven columns and enough horizontal room.
changes: Remove rounded-lg and all shadows from Calendar root. Also update generated CalendarDayButton and classNames for day buttons, selected states and caption selectors; wrapper styling alone will not remove internal rounded-full. Preserve Calendar controlled date and captionLayout dropdown.
snippet:
<Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate}
  captionLayout="dropdown" className="fb-calendar" />
behavior: Retain the library keyboard grid, localized weekday ordering, disabled dates and screen-reader date labels. Today must remain different from selected. Do not stretch condensed Anton onto numeric day cells.
integration: Use fixture dates where a full date is meaningful; keep the existing fixture-number pager for matchweek navigation.

name: Date picker · Dialog composition
purpose: Compact date trigger without the excluded Popover primitive.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: date trigger neutral surface. Secondary: label #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: calendar selection #FF4B44 with black text; focus uses tertiary ink.
shape: Standalone trigger 8px corners, ≥44px height, width 212–240px; dialog panel square, width min(360px, viewport − 32px). Integrated trigger is square.
changes: Replace Popover/PopoverContent/PopoverTrigger with Dialog, DialogContent and DialogTrigger; include DialogTitle. Keep controlled pending and committed dates separately; Apply commits, Cancel discards. On mobile use the same accessible dialog or a Drawer.
snippet:
<DialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" icon={<CalendarDays />} />}>
  {date ? format(date, "PPP") : "Pick a date"}
</DialogTrigger>
<DialogContent className="fb-popup">
  <DialogTitle>Fixture date</DialogTitle>
  <Calendar mode="single" selected={draftDate} onSelect={setDraftDate} />
</DialogContent>
behavior: Provide a visible title, cancel/apply controls, initial focus, Escape close and restored trigger focus. A formatted date is read aloud; the calendar icon is decorative.
integration: This explicitly supersedes the briefing’s Popover-based date-picker example.

name: Carousel
purpose: Compact player-form or fixture highlights, where lateral browsing is useful.
typography: Anton title 20px/130%, weight 400, tracking +0.03em, uppercase; AT Aero body 14px/150%, weight 400; AT Aero actions 14px/100%, weight 600.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square slides and cards with 1px separators; fixed internal gaps 12–16px. Square 44px arrow controls because they belong to the larger graphic. Reserve arrow space inside the section, not outside the viewport.
changes: Remove Card rounded/shadow defaults and p-1 wrappers that only accommodate shadows. Use Carousel root, content and items as provided; style Previous/Next with shape square and outline variant. Match slide height without forcing every slide to aspect-square.
snippet:
<Carousel className="fb-carousel">
  <CarouselContent>{slides.map((slide) => (
    <CarouselItem key={slide.id}><Card className="fb-panel">{slide.content}</Card></CarouselItem>
  ))}</CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious className="fb-button--square" />
  <CarouselNext className="fb-button--square" />
</Carousel>
behavior: No autoplay. Retain labeled previous/next controls, swipe and keyboard behavior from the primitive; report slide position without excessive announcements.
integration: Potentially reuse for player-detail form widgets; keep core market data in a stable list/table.

name: Collapsible
purpose: Additional player statistics or bid details beneath a permanent summary row.
typography: Anton section title 18px/130%, weight 400; AT Aero summary/body 14px/150%, weight 400; values weight 500.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square border rows, 12–16px padding, 8px vertical spacing. Toggle square because it is attached to the section; no rounded-md on any inner row.
changes: Remove rounded-md from fixed and expanded panels. Apply fb-panel or bordered row classes to both. Use a square icon button in CollapsibleTrigger; rotate the chevron 90deg or switch icon at most, avoiding height bounce.
snippet:
<CollapsibleTrigger render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon" shape="square"
  aria-label="Toggle player details" />}>
  <ChevronsUpDown aria-hidden="true" />
</CollapsibleTrigger>
behavior: Keep expanded state on the trigger via the primitive; content stays semantically adjacent to the summary. The summary and its title remain visible when closed.
integration: Use for player-detail sections that currently occupy large stacks of widgets.

name: Combobox
purpose: Searchable team or owner selection; free-form player search remains an Input Group.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square input and popup; ≥44px options, 8px–12px padding, matching trigger width. Popup max height 240px with square scrollbars.
changes: Change generated ComboboxInput and ComboboxContent rounded/shadow defaults. Add fb-combobox-input and fb-popup hooks, use fb-item for highlighted options. Supply stable IDs for objects, a readable label and explicit empty results. Combobox internal popup is permitted; no generic Popover wrapper.
snippet:
<Combobox items={teams}>
  <ComboboxInput className="fb-combobox-input" placeholder="Select team" />
  <ComboboxContent className="fb-popup">
    <ComboboxEmpty>No teams match.</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>{(team) => <ComboboxItem key={team} value={team}
      className="fb-item">{team}</ComboboxItem>}</ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
behavior: Preserve library arrow keys, Enter, Escape and active-option semantics. Clearing the filter must be available. Labels must not rely on placeholders.
integration: Team and owner lists in PlayersListHead and MarketListHead are candidates; retain current URL filter state where used.

name: Dialog
purpose: Confirm a bid, clause payment, sale or lineup action.
typography: Anton title 20px/130%, weight 400, tracking +0.03em, uppercase; AT Aero body 14px/150%, weight 400; AT Aero actions 14px/100%, weight 600.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square centered panel, 1px border, 24px padding; width min(480px, viewport − 32px). Solid neutral overlay with opacity; no blur, shadow or scaling spring. Standalone footer actions may have 8px corners.
changes: Use generated Dialog primitive for focus/inert behavior; apply fb-popup to DialogContent and fb-section-title to DialogTitle. Remove rounded, shadow-lg, ring-shadow and zoom animation utilities in generated source. Use a short opacity transition and explicit title, description, amount and actions.
snippet:
<DialogContent className="fb-popup">
  <DialogHeader><DialogTitle className="fb-section-title">Confirm bid</DialogTitle>
    <DialogDescription>Submit €1,250,000 for this player?</DialogDescription>
  </DialogHeader>
  <DialogFooter><Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
    <Button icon={<Gavel />} loading={pending}>Place bid</Button></DialogFooter>
</DialogContent>
behavior: Focus trap, Escape close and focus restoration come from the primitive. Preserve in-dialog errors on failure; do not close on a failed mutation. Block accidental repeated confirmation while pending.
integration: Replace custom components/Modal.tsx and its spring/scale animations; wire existing MarketActionDialogs handlers and validation.

name: Drawer
purpose: Mobile filter editor or compact detail inspection from the bottom edge.
typography: Anton title 20px/130%, weight 400, tracking +0.03em, uppercase; AT Aero body 14px/150%, weight 400; AT Aero actions 14px/100%, weight 600.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square top corners; maximum height 85dvh; 20px padding with safe-area-inset-bottom; rectangular 32×3px handle. Footer actions may be rounded.
changes: Remove rounded-t and shadow defaults from DrawerContent and handle. Use fb-popup styles; set bounded scroll region with persistent title/actions. Keep the library drag/dismiss logic and short translation behavior.
snippet:
Player filters
{filters}
behavior: Swipe is an addition to visible Close/Apply controls; never the only exit. No bounce. Keep unsaved filter changes clear and focus restoration intact.
integration: Use as the mobile alternative to the desktop Sheet; avoid nested Drawer+Dialog stacks.

name: Dropdown menu
purpose: Small contextual actions on a player or account; not site navigation.
typography: AT Aero 14px/140%, weight 400; group labels 12px/140%, weight 500, uppercase; shortcut text 12px.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square popup and rows, 1px border, min width 180px, padding 4px; rows ≥36px desktop /44px touch. Square submenus and separators; no shadows.
changes: Update generated content, subcontent and item style defaults, not only trigger. Apply fb-popup, fb-item and shared neutral separators. Keep destructives labeled and pair red icon with readable content text.
snippet:
<DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button size="icon" variant="ghost" shape="square"
  aria-label="Player actions" />}>…</DropdownMenuTrigger>
<DropdownMenuContent className="fb-popup" align="end">
  <DropdownMenuItem className="fb-item">View player</DropdownMenuItem>
</DropdownMenuContent>
behavior: Retain primitive menu keyboard and submenu behavior. Disabled actions remain readable with an explanatory reason elsewhere; avoid expensive operations on hover.
integration: Reuse squad-player action menus; keep the top navigation limited to Lineup, Market and Players.

name: Input
purpose: Amounts, text values and form fields.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square 44px field, 1px control border, 12px horizontal padding; width 100% of its form column. Error border 2px plus text message; no shadow focus ring.
changes: Replace rounded-md and shadow-xs in generated Input with fb-input. Retain native input props and explicit label. Use inputMode decimal for currency and validate amount separately; avoid formatted symbols inside editable numeric content.
snippet: {error || "Amount in euros"}
behavior: Show focus via a 2px tertiary outline. No placeholder-only labels. Error text names the fix; keep entered value on failure.
integration: Replace/review NumericCounterField interactions without losing step, min, max or balance validation.

name: Input group · Search
purpose: Player and market name/team/owner search.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square 44px combined field. Search icon 18px, 12px left inset; right-side Clear control is square as part of the group. Responsive width 240px minimum when space allows, otherwise 100%.
changes: Use InputGroup, InputGroupInput and InputGroupAddon. Remove wrapper rounded/shadow/ring defaults and duplicate child borders. Use focus-within outline. Give Clear an accessible name; preserve active-filter count outside the placeholder.
snippet:
<InputGroup className="fb-input-group">
  <InputGroupAddon><Search aria-hidden="true" /></InputGroupAddon>
  <InputGroupInput aria-label="Search players" placeholder="Name, team or owner" />
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">{clearButton}</InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
behavior: Search updates locally/through current state management; typing focus never jumps. Announce result count politely after updates, and distinguish no matches from load errors.
integration: Adapt MarketPlayerSearch and shared MarketToolbar; retain useDeferredValue and current matching behavior.

name: Native select
purpose: Short fixed options such as lineup formations.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square 44px field; formation width 140–180px desktop and flexible on small screens. Controlled 18px decorative chevron inset 12px from the right edge; reserve 44px end padding so the label cannot collide with the icon.
changes: Wrap NativeSelect in a position:relative fb-select-shell. Hide the platform arrow with appearance:none, reserve padding-inline-end:44px, and render a pointer-events:none chevron at inset-inline-end:12px. If generated NativeSelect already owns its chevron, reposition that icon instead of adding a second one. Preserve options/value/onChange, remove rounding/shadows, and keep the native option popup behavior.
behavior: Native selection behavior and keyboard access remain. Use this simpler control when options are short and fixed; custom Select is an alternative, not a second control next to it.
integration: Current LineupPage formation <select> is the direct migration point.

name: Navigation bar
purpose: Exactly Lineup, Market and Players destinations.
typography: AT Aero 14px/140%, weight 500, tracking 0.01em, uppercase. Product wordmark may use Anton 20px/130%, weight 400.
colors: Main: surface #FFFFFF / #24242B. Secondary: text #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active 4px bottom rule #FF4B44; hover coral #FFC2BF / #B85A55 with paired label.
shape: Single flat horizontal rectangle, no floating pill container; links square, min height 56px, 16–20px horizontal padding. Small screens can use three equal-width columns; account controls remain outside these destinations.
changes: Use React Router NavLink, not shadcn NavigationMenu and no submenus. Lineup path is / and needs end to avoid matching every page. Remove existing nav tab SVG background shells and shared shadow; keep decorative icons accessible-hidden.
snippet:
<nav className="fb-nav" aria-label="Main">
  <NavLink to="/" end>Lineup</NavLink>
  <NavLink to="/market">Market</NavLink>
  <NavLink to="/players">Players</NavLink>
</nav>
behavior: Keep visible active underline plus aria-current supplied by NavLink. Player detail belongs to the Players context; explicitly keep Players visually active on detail routes. Contact remains a footer route.
integration: Update features/shell/Header.tsx and Header.css; preserve league/account selection and auth gates outside the three-page menu.

name: Pagination
purpose: Numbered results navigation in groups of three.
typography: AT Aero numbers 14px/140%, weight 500; context 12px/140%, weight 400; tabular numerals.
colors: Main: neutral surface. Secondary: text #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: current page #FF4B44 with black text.
shape: Three square 44px cells with 4px gaps; no Previous/Next words or arrow controls. Separate muted page-count caption may be shown.
changes: Replace Previous/Next buttons with NumberPagination.tsx (complete Appendix B). Use a sliding three-number window: start=clamp(current−1,1,total−2), adjusted for totals under three. Selecting the right boundary exposes the next number; selecting the left boundary exposes the previous number.
snippet:
<NumberPagination page={currentPage} totalPages={totalPages}
  onPageChange={(page) => setSearchParams(withPlayersPage(searchParams, page),
    { replace: true })} />
behavior: Always mark aria-current=page; hide when only one page. Clamp page after result count shrinks. Keep keyboard focus within the pagination when its window updates and announce the new count; do not force focus to the table.
integration: Direct replacement for the bottom navigation in PlayersPage.tsx; retain current search-param paging.

name: Popover · Excluded
purpose: Explicit exclusion from the component set.
typography: Not applicable; do not introduce a styled Popover.
colors: Main: not applicable. Secondary: not applicable. Tertiary: not applicable.
shape: No Popover primitive or Popover panel in the refactor.
changes: Remove generic Popover composition from the supplied DatePicker. Use Dialog/Drawer for date editing and Sheet/Drawer for column filters. Select, Combobox, DropdownMenu and Tooltip retain their own purpose-specific primitive popup behavior.
behavior: A popup used internally by a Select or Combobox is not a separate general-purpose Popover component. This decision keeps the briefing coherent without deleting essential selection behavior.
integration: Review PlayersColumnFilterPopover and analogous market filter UI during migration.

name: Radio group
purpose: Mutually exclusive position/availability filters.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square option rows with 8px gap and minimum 44px targets. An 18px radio indicator may remain circular to communicate native radio semantics; the surrounding graphic is rectangular.
changes: Preserve RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem behavior; style option labels as square rows, selected row via coral highlight and a clear checked indicator. No rounded option cards or shadows.
snippet:
<RadioGroup value={position} onValueChange={setPosition}>
  <label className="fb-item"><RadioGroupItem value="forward" /> Forwards</label>
  <label className="fb-item"><RadioGroupItem value="midfielder" /> Midfielders</label>
</RadioGroup>
behavior: One choice per group, arrow-key navigation, visible group label. A neutral All option makes clearing the filter explicit.
integration: Use in player/market filters; keep filter enum values and URL serialization stable.

name: Scroll area
purpose: Overflow lists and bounded filter/detail panels.
typography: Inherit child text roles; AT Aero 14px body, 12px helper, weight 400. Scrollbar has no typography.
colors: Main: neutral surface. Secondary: track #EDEDEF / #303039. Tertiary: thumb #24CEE5; use neutral high-contrast thumb if cyan is distracting in dense tables.
shape: Square viewport, track and thumb; 8px desktop track and normal native scroll interaction. Only constrain regions that genuinely overflow.
changes: Remove rounded-full from generated ScrollBar and thumb. Keep ScrollAreaViewport and corner square; bound height and keep labels outside the viewport. Native overflow:auto is acceptable when custom scrollbars are unnecessary.
snippet: <ScrollArea className="fb-scroll-area">{filterOptions}</ScrollArea>
behavior: Keep keyboard scrolling and touch intact, never hide all scrollbars. Do not create nested scroll traps or horizontal scrolling of the entire app.
integration: Use inside Sheet/Drawer and the wide player table; existing pitch/body layout keeps its own overflow rules.

name: Select
purpose: Custom fixed-option selector when native select is insufficient.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square 44px trigger and popup, ≥44px square options; popup width aligns with trigger. Trigger has 12px padding on both sides, 12px value/icon gap and an 18px nonshrinking chevron. Native visual specimens reserve 44px end padding and position the chevron 12px from the edge.
changes: Edit SelectTrigger, SelectContent and SelectItem defaults. Make the trigger inline content a flex row with justify-between, padding-inline:12px and gap:12px; keep its built-in chevron 18px and shrink-0 with no negative margin. Remove rounded and shadow classes. Use fb-select-trigger, fb-popup and fb-item; preserve the selected checkmark and controlled value. Do not add a second chevron.
snippet:
<Select value={formation} onValueChange={setFormation}>
  <SelectTrigger className="fb-select-trigger"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent className="fb-popup">
    <SelectItem className="fb-item" value="4,3,3">4–3–3</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
behavior: Use the primitive’s selection, focus, typeahead and Escape behavior. Option colors alone never indicate selection. Label the trigger from the visible formation label.
integration: Alternative to Native Select for formation; choose one implementation consistently.

name: Separator
purpose: Thin structure between sections or action groups.
typography: No font, size or weight. Text surrounding it inherits its section role.
colors: Main: structural line #CDCDD2 / #50505B. Secondary: surrounding surface #FFFFFF / #24242B. Tertiary: none; coral is reserved for active rules, not every divider.
shape: Straight 1px rectangle; horizontal full width or vertical with explicit height; no rounded ends.
changes: Keep Separator primitive; set the background token and remove redundant shadows/margins. Pass decorative when visual-only; use orientation vertical where appropriate.
snippet: <Separator decorative className="fb-separator" />
behavior: Do not announce purely decorative separators. Spacing communicates grouping; avoid dense repeated lines.
integration: Useful in Header account controls, Dialog footers and filter groups.

name: Sheet
purpose: Desktop side filter editor or contextual player information.
typography: Anton title 20px/130%, weight 400, tracking +0.03em, uppercase; AT Aero body 14px/150%, weight 400; AT Aero actions 14px/100%, weight 600.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square side panel; width 360px desktop, max-width calc(100vw − 24px); full viewport height; 24px padding; thin inner boundary. No rounding or drop shadow.
changes: Apply fb-popup and side-specific sizing to SheetContent; remove shadow and excessive slide animation classes. Retain title, description, close button and primitive focus behavior. Include filter Apply/Clear buttons in a stable footer.
snippet:
Market filters
{filters}
behavior: 160–200ms translation only, no bounce. Restore trigger focus. On small screens switch to Drawer without duplicating open states.
integration: Replacement candidate for custom column-filter overlays; preserve pending versus applied filter state.

name: Skeleton
purpose: Local partial loading placeholders when layout is already known.
typography: No font/weight; dimensions mirror actual text or thumbnails. Keep a single AT Aero 12px loading label outside decorative placeholders.
colors: Main: placeholder #EDEDEF / #303039. Secondary: neutral surface. Tertiary: no accent required; coral belongs to the primary loader.
shape: Square bars and rectangles with actual content heights; no circular avatars unless the final content is circular. No gradient or moving shimmer.
changes: Use fb-skeleton flat background and opacity pulse; remove current gradient backgrounds and shadowed skeleton tiles. aria-hidden=true on individual shapes; one busy/status label for the region.
behavior: Stop animation for reduced motion. Use Pulse Ring for initial/full-panel loading; skeletons only for content whose size can be reasonably predicted.
integration: Update PlayerScreenLoading.css and MarketScreenLoading.css gradient rules.

name: Switch
purpose: Binary filters such as show only favorites or available players.
typography: AT Aero; content 14px/150%, weight 400; labels 12px/140%, weight 500; tracking 0.01em on labels.
colors: Main: off track #EDEDEF / #303039. Secondary: off thumb #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: on track #24CEE5 with black thumb.
shape: 44×24px skewed rectangular track (−15deg), square thumb 16×16px; total target ≥44px. Keep label and focus outline unskewed. No pill track or round thumb.
changes: Retain Switch primitive. Remove rounded-full on track and thumb; wrap the visual track for skewX while the root remains unskewed. Use data-checked from the installed Base UI primitive, not Radix-only data-state selectors without checking. Native preview uses aria-checked styling.
behavior: Checked state uses position and color; Space toggles; announce role/label/checked. Keep thumb travel within track. Do not transform hit targets or content labels.
integration: Optional player/market filter; favorite storage and filtering remain under existing hooks/state.

name: Table · Standard and player/market variants
purpose: Simple statistics tables and the main player/market list.
typography: AT Aero headers 12px/140%, weight 500, uppercase; cells 14px/150%, weight 400; player names/primary values weight 500; numbers right-aligned with tabular numerals.
colors: Main: surface — #FFFFFF light / #24242B dark. Secondary: content — #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: active or focus accent — #FF4B44 in both modes.
shape: Square table and rows; 1px horizontal dividers, no floating cards or shadows. Standard row min 44px; rich player row 64–80px. 32px rectangular image region, aligned actions. Contain horizontal overflow for dense data.
changes: Style Table wrappers with fb-table. Current player/market lists use ul-based rows: preserve row data/handlers, then deliberately decide semantic table versus labeled list for the rich layout. Put sortable headings in buttons with aria-sort on th. Do not make whole rows click targets when they contain action buttons.
snippet: Player Value{rows.map((row) => {row.name} {row.valueLabel} )}
behavior: Form and value changes use icon + signed value + color. Favorite toggle, bid button and player link are separate controls. Empty, degraded and error states remain explicit; do not render incomplete data as zero.
integration: MarketRowView, MarketListHead, PlayersListHead and PlayersPage rows retain current points, values, owner and availability content; apply style to PlayerDetail statistical tables too.

name: Toast
purpose: Successful lineup save or bid submission; actionable mutation failure.
typography: AT Aero title 14px/140%, weight 500; description 12px/140%, weight 400; action 14px/100%, weight 600.
colors: Main: surface #FFFFFF / #24242B. Secondary: text #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: 4px left rail #10BD00 success / #FF4B44 failure / #FFC413 or #CA9C10 warning.
shape: Square bounded rectangle, border 1px, no shadow; width ≤360px with 16px viewport margins; content/close aligned in a row. Round standalone action only if present.
changes: Use current Base UI Toast provider/manager and style content with fb-toast; do not silently substitute a different toaster API. Emit from confirmed mutation success, not from click. Deduplicate repeated errors; leave a persistent error in the form if recovery is required.
behavior: Status for success, alert for urgent error; visible close button, pause timeout while focused/hovered. Success around 5s; actionable error persists until dismissed. UI confirmation of a bid never invents an upstream success.
integration: Integrate useLineupBoard save flow and useMarketActions onSuccess/onError; retain current form-level errors.

name: Toggle · Favorite player
purpose: Follow a player from Players or Market.
typography: Icon 18–20px; optional AT Aero label 14px/140%, weight 500. Tooltip/help 12px/140%, weight 400.
colors: Main: unchanged transparent/neutral button surface in both states. Secondary: inactive bookmark #35353D / #E5E5E5 and unchanged neutral control border. Tertiary: active bookmark stroke/fill #FF4B44 in both modes; focus uses the normal tertiary-ink outline.
shape: Square 44px integrated hit target with a neutral 1px border; 18–20px bookmark icon centered in both axes. Selection does not color the button background or border. Only the icon becomes coral and filled.
changes: Use Toggle with controlled pressed state and onPressedChange. Keep the button surface and border neutral for hover/pressed states; target the child Bookmark SVG for coral stroke/fill. Use aria-pressed in the native preview; use the generated Base UI pressed-state attribute in production (or an explicit class driven by the same controlled boolean). Keep stored favorite IDs and the player-specific accessible name.
snippet:
<Toggle pressed={favorite} onPressedChange={() => onToggleFavorite()}
  aria-label={`Favorite ${player.name}`} className="fb-toggle">
  <Bookmark fill={favorite ? "currentColor" : "none"} aria-hidden="true" />
</Toggle>
behavior: Favorite is a local follow state in current code; do not imply notifications already exist. Notify options can be an additional feature once implemented. Keyboard toggle and focus ring stay visible.
integration: Replace features/players/PlayerBookmarkButton.css presentation while preserving favorites.ts behavior.

name: Tooltip
purpose: Short explanatory help for icons, form/availability markers and disabled actions.
typography: AT Aero 12px/140%, weight 400, tracking 0.01em; sentence case for readability.
colors: Main: neutral surface #FFFFFF / #24242B. Secondary: content #35353D / #E5E5E5. Tertiary: border #797981 / #9898A3; focus on trigger uses tertiary ink.
shape: Square rectangular body, 8×12px padding, max width 260px; small optional triangular arrow; no rounded-md or shadow.
changes: Use TooltipProvider, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger and TooltipContent. Replace manual CSS has-hover-tooltip-panel handling. Apply fb-tooltip; remove generated shadow/rounded classes, retain arrow only if it improves placement.
snippet:
<Tooltip><TooltipTrigger render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon"
  shape="square" aria-label="Availability information" />}>
  <Info aria-hidden="true" />
</TooltipTrigger><TooltipContent className="fb-tooltip">
  Player availability is not confirmed.
</TooltipContent></Tooltip>
behavior: Show on hover and keyboard focus, close on Escape; use a short ~300ms delay. Tooltip never contains form controls. Keep essential validation visible; disabled controls may need a focusable wrapper, but must not accidentally activate.
integration: Replace TooltipPanel.css and manual CurrentFixtureTooltip / player availability hover panels where the content is genuinely short. Rich interactive content belongs in Dialog/Sheet.
